info.title: PDS Self-Auditing & AI Virtual Inspection System API

post.description: Authenticates an officer with email and password, setting an HttpOnly session cookie.
Logs out current user, records audit event, and clears session cookie.

get.description: Returns the authenticated user's profile, role permissions, and scope.
Returns scoped list of cases sorted by latest risk score descending.
Returns single case detail, action timeline, and allowed_actions for current user.

post.description: Executes state machine action on a case in scope with validation and append-only audit.

get.description: Returns area-level metrics filtered by caller's scope.
Returns list of officers in caller's scope with aggregate performance stats.
Returns detailed profile, permissions, assigned cases, actions, and area flag rate.
Returns scoped audit feed of case actions.
Lists all users (admin only). Never returns password_hash.

post.description: Creates a new user and returns a temporary password once (admin only).

patch.description: Updates role, scope, or active status of a user (admin only).

post.description: Resets user password and returns temporary password once (admin only).

get.description: Lists access log entries from append-only audit_log (admin only).
Returns metadata about the PDS system dataset and available weeks.
Returns summary KPIs, evaluation metrics, and visit outcomes scoped to user.
Returns ranked list of shops sorted by risk score descending within user's scope.
Returns detailed audit file for a single shop within user scope (404 if out of scope).

post.description: Triggers an audit run for a specific week (admin only).
Stores officer visit outcome feedback for a shop within user scope.
